misconceptions.description: Using a nonperpendicular distance for the moment arm
misconceptions.trigger: learner multiplies force by a slanted or convenient distance
misconceptions.feedback: Moment magnitude in 2D uses the perpendicular distance from the reference point to the line of action of the force.

misconceptions.trigger: learner reports only a positive magnitude without rotational sense
misconceptions.feedback: Moments have direction. Use a consistent sign convention such as counterclockwise positive and clockwise negative.

misconceptions.description: Adding component moments without considering sign
misconceptions.trigger: learner applies Varignon's theorem using only magnitudes
misconceptions.feedback: When using components, each component moment must be added algebraically with the correct sign based on rotational sense.
